changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionItemDependentChange') BEGIN create table api.ExecutionItemDependentChange ( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier not null, ItemNumber int not null, DependentChangeType int not null, --1=Parent Change [Action] int not null, --1=Add, 2=Change, 3=Delete Payload varchar(2000) not null, constraint [PK_ApiExecutionItemDependentChange] primary key clustered ( ExecutionID desc, ItemNumber asc, DependentChangeType asc, [Action] asc ) ) END
